# bridge_capture_golden.txt — the PER-SIDE (p1/p2) protocol streams of the REAL Node BattleStream.
# The byte target for the Rust port's BRIDGE surface (getPlayerStreams split + the |request| JSON emitter).
# Captured EXACTLY as local_sim_bridge.js pumps them: >start/>player to omniscient, per-side chunks recorded
# in yield order, choices driven off the omniscient battle object (any legal move/switch), gen3ou, to game-end.
# Record grammar (TAB-delimited; the raw-line payload is everything after the final tab):
#   SCEN  <id>
#   TEAM  <id>  <p1|p2>  <packed team>
#   INIT  <id>  <battleNo>  <seed m,n,o,p>  <formatid>
#   CMD   <id>  <battleNo>  <cmdNo>  <side>  <choice>
#   CHUNK <id>  <battleNo>  <side>  <chunkNo>  <lineNo>  <raw line>
#   END   <id>  <battleNo>  <ended:0|1>  <winner:p1|p2|tie|none>
# MASTER_SEED 1112687687  format gen3ou  battles 30
